script: How many NBA players are left from the 2000s? 2003, just LeBron James. 2004, nobody. 2005, no one. Chris Paul was the last player of the '05 draft class and he retired last season with the Clippers, and we all know how that one ended. 2006, Kyle Lowry technically signed a one-day contract with the Raptors, but he is officially retired. 2007, we have Kevin Durant, Al Horford still with the Warriors, Mike Conley, and Jeff Green. 2008, Brook Lopez is still on the Clippers, DeAndre Jordan signed a one-year deal with the Pelicans, Russell Westbrook, Kevin Love, and Eric Gordon are unsigned free agents, so they're technically not retired. 2009 has Steph Curry, James Harden, DeMar DeRozan, Jrue Holiday, James Johnson, and Taj Gibson. 2010, Paul George is the only active player from the 2010 draft class. The second to last one was John Wall, but he's definitely been since retired. So from the start of the first decade of the 2000s, there are only about 17 NBA players left depending on how you want to count it, cause there's a lot of technicalities.

what_makes_it_work: Instantly engaging trivia question combined with dynamic animation and rapid year-by-year pacing.
Clever inside NBA jokes, humorous caricature expressions, and timely references to recent signings and retirements.
Perfect seamless loop where the ending statement directly answers and circles back to the opening hook question.
